gloss: The one plugin, pinned to a web-tools commit at install and moved to main's tip by its own refresher each session.
Every plugin skill's description sits in context from the start, whether or not the skill is ever invoked.
Loads SURFACING.md and QUALIFIED-WRITING.md from copies shipped beside it, when the session-start directive tells the session to.
The guide-PR lifecycle, delivered by the PR-subscribe hint at the moment a pull request is opened.
Moves the plugin to main's tip and prints one line when the pin moves; skills from the new pin appear within the session.
Runs every checkout's own .claude/hooks/session-*.sh, whatever the project root is.
Prints one line telling the session to invoke /portable:default when the conventions have not arrived another way.
Tells a session with no session store checked out to fetch one, falling back to mehrlander/web-tools-private.
Refuses an edit that narrows page text to a reading column, one of the house-style rules.
Refuses a scheduled self check-in; a subscribed PR already wakes the session.
Denies AskUserQuestion and says to ask in prose. Whether PreToolUse fires for that tool is not verified.
After a PR is created, reminds the session to subscribe to it and delivers the surfacing course.
After a documentation edit, reminds the session that governing prose needs specific permission.
Turns an MCP approval wall into the sandbox-traps diagnosis when it happens.
Writes the session record at each stop, where a checked-out store declares itself; the source of the Measured lens.
web-tools' own contract, loaded whenever web-tools is checked out, whatever the session root.
Denies AskUserQuestion, but is read only when web-tools itself is the session root.
session-githooks.sh and session-start.sh, run by the plugin's dispatcher.
Read by the plugin's hooks for declarations such as a conventions opt-out; never itself in context.
What you type, and the harness's own system prompt around it.
Files read, commands run, searches and connector calls: what the session fetched for itself.
PR activity, task notifications and stop-hook feedback, injected between turns.
Resume and compaction summaries: earlier conversation carried forward in a form the session did not write.
